records.name: dsh-plugin-error-radar

evidence.summary: Real npm install of dsh-plugin-error-radar@0.2.0 into an isolated profile.
/radar reported web_fetch 4 calls, 100% errors and 4 consecutive failures from fixture tool-trace JSONL input.
evidence.observation:
工具可靠性雷达（按错误率排序）:
  web_fetch 4 次 · 错误率 100% · 连败 4 · p95 5300ms
⚠ 告警:
  - web_fetch 错误率 100%（4/4），超过告警线
  - web_fetch 连续失败 4 次

evidence.summary: /health --days 7 produced a go/no-go verdict over the same trace fixture.
evidence.observation:
工具健康 · 近 7 天 · 2 个工具 6 次调用 · 错误率 67%（4 次失败）
判定 ❌ 有系统性故障：web_fetch 连续失败 4 次

evidence.summary: A rejected config (errorRateAlert=999) kept the previous instance; /radar remained usable.
Disabled: contributions became empty and invocation was refused. Re-enabled: commands registered again. Uninstalled: package directory and registry entries were removed; plugin data was kept.
A local 0.2.1 package that throws during activation was rejected; 0.2.0 stayed loaded and /radar continued to work.
A fresh service instance restored the installed version, config and commands from market-state.json.

records.notes: Fixture trace JSONL is input data; plugin output was produced by the real plugin. The package has no DSH Web client half.

records.name: dsh-plugin-health

evidence.summary: Real npm install; host half loaded with the pinned @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 0.2.2-rc.1 peer.
plugin_health returned a structured report for the isolated DSH home.
Updated the installed 3.0.5 to 3.0.4; the previous package was retained as a rollback backup.
Rolled back to 3.0.5 from the backup; plugin_health executed again after the swap.

records.notes: The package ships a DSH Web client half. The host tool is verified; the browser UI is not mounted by ConeCode and is listed as missing.

records.name: dsh-find-plugin

evidence.summary: Installation without an exemption was refused with the exact unmet peer requirement.
Installed with an exact-version exemption and the shared 0.2.2-rc.1 tool peer.
find_dsh_plugin returned ranked, real GitHub dsh-plugin results.

records.notes: Author-declared peer range only covers DSH 0.1.x. The tool worked with the baseline peer, but this is a partial compatibility result and is marked as such.

records.name: dsh-storage-probe

evidence.summary: A real Cordis plugin opened a zod-validated domain through @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain.
The fixture tool read the durably written record from the JSON backend.
The same record was read after a full worker/service restart.

records.notes: Local compatibility fixture, not community compatibility evidence. It verifies the official DSH storage seam, not LayerFS.

records.name: dsh-layerfs

evidence.summary: Static/preflight assessment of Ephemeral-AI-Lab/dsh-layerfs@b9bf3bc: Docker daemon not running, LayerFS checkout/bundle/image absent, required DSH host services and Web client host not provided. No install or fake load was attempted.

records.notes: LayerFS requires DSH host services and a Web interface that ConeCode does not provide.
